newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes higher in quiet trade.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market ended higher on Monday, but trading was subdued as foreign investors kept to the sidelines, traders said.
Operators expected a slight uptrend later this week due to higher interest in cement makers and oil refineries.

The independent index VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, rose by 2.5 percent to 3,496.8 points, while another unofficial index, the BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, went up by 5.11 percent to 2,647.78. Both indices are based on average prices.
Advances led declines 125 to 93, with 294 flat.
"Some cement makers and oil refineries were in higher demand, with investors' buying appetite leading them to a higher close," one broker said.
Cement maker Romcim firmed 1,000 lei to 73,000, while oil refinery Petrobrazi closed 500 lei stronger at 27,500. Another refinery, Petromidia, finished flat at 19,500 lei.
Wire maker Ductil, a small-cap which has performed well in recent weeks, gained 50 lei to 1,550.
Overall, turnover fell sharply to 9.1 billion from 30.6 billion last Friday, when the level was boosted by several large special deals.
